hero.lead: I'm Romain Piau. I build desktop apps, developer tools and Minecraft projects, from the first idea all the way to production.

mm.desc: Installs Minecraft modpacks published on GitHub straight into CurseForge in one click, and updates them without losing worlds or settings. A built-in Studio helps authors publish to GitHub, CurseForge, Modrinth and Hangar.

ula.desc: Formatted courses, quizzes and interactive exercises, with a local server that runs the code in answers (SQL, Python, C, JavaScript) and calls Claude for help, grading and new quizzes. On-demand course catalogue, profiles and study paths, automatic updates.

imp.desc: A Discord music bot that lowers the volume as soon as someone speaks, then brings it back smoothly. Real-time web dashboard: queue, playlists, YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, local files, crossfades and loudness matching.

legal.title: Legal notice and privacy
legal.body:
Publisher

This personal website is published by Romain Piau, in a non-professional capacity. Romain Piau is also responsible for its publication.

Contact: romainpiau10 (at) gmail.com, or send a message on LinkedIn.

Host

Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States. cloudflare.com

Intellectual property

The text and visuals of this site belong to Romain Piau unless stated otherwise. Its source code is published under the MIT license. Minecraft, CurseForge, Modrinth, GitHub and LinkedIn are trademarks of their respective owners; this site is not affiliated with any of them.

Personal data

This site asks for no information and sets no advertising or tracking cookies, so there is no consent banner.

  • Analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits in aggregate, with no cookie and no identifier.
  • Language: when you land on the home page, the country Cloudflare infers from your IP address picks French or English. The site does not keep it.
  • lang cookie: it remembers the language you pick with the FR / EN switch, for one year. It is needed for the service you ask for.
  • Theme and animations: your light or dark theme and animation pause choices stay in your browser (local storage). They are never sent anywhere.
  • Hosting: like any host, Cloudflare processes your IP address to deliver the pages and protect the site.
  • GitHub: if the list of repositories can't be loaded from this site, your browser requests it from GitHub directly, which then receives your IP address.

For any question about your data, email me or message me on LinkedIn. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.
